content_sections.heading: Mizoram PSC Assistant Sub-Inspector Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Mizoram PSC Assistant Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, physical standards, computer proficiency and Mizo language proficiency requirements mentioned in the official notification. The required educational qualification for the Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) post is: Bachelor’s degree from a recognized University. Candidates must meet the prescribed physical measurement standards mentioned in the recruitment notification. Minimum Height: 157 cm Minimum Weight: 45 kg No chest measurement standard is prescribed for female candidates. Candidates applying for the Mizoram PSC Assistant Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026 must qualify in the Physical Efficiency Test as prescribed by the Mizoram Public Service Commission. Candidates must possess computer proficiency as prescribed under the Mizoram Group ‘A’, ‘B’ and ‘C’ Posts Service/Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2023. Candidates must achieve the qualifying marks in the Mizo Language Proficiency Test as prescribed by the Government. Candidates who studied Mizo subject in Class-X standard (HSLC) or above within Mizoram or who opted for Mizo subject as MIL outside Mizoram are exempted from appearing in the qualifying test paper.
